ios.desc:
YOUR DAILY PROGRESS LOOP
- Do your daily habits and keep your streak alive
- Complete them all to roll for a daily XP bonus
- Chat in the feed to stay accountable and locked in together

Every day counts — consistency builds momentum, and momentum builds you.

WHAT MAKES TRACKWME DIFFERENT
- Cute turtle companion that keeps you motivated
- Screen time app blocker to block distracting apps and open only when needed
- Streak system for doing at least one habit a day
- Journal, Mood Tracker to write down your wins
- League leaderboard: climb from Bronze to Diamond each week
- Daily bonus rolls for completing every habit
- Personal Analytics to analyze your habits
- Feed system to chat, share, and stay accountable with others
- Friendly competition that makes progress fun

COMING SOON
- Unlockable turtle skins and accessories
- Unlockable Achievements to flex on

BUILT BY ONE PERSON WHO GETS IT

I’m an indie developer building the tool I needed — to make consistency fun, social, and rewarding again.

Get Trackwme to fix your life around!
Your turtle, and your future self — will thank you.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION*

A Trackwme SUBSCRIPTION is required to use and enjoy full access to features and content. If you choose a Trackwme subscription, payment will be charged to your Apple Account after the free trial ends.

The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your Apple Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. From Apple Account settings you can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your Apple Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. If you subscribe before your trial ends, the remaining free trial period will be forfeited when your purchase is confirmed.

Privacy Policy: https://www.trackwme.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.trackwme.com/tos

quotes.text:
Hey Everyone!

This is my first app that I have made and it’s called Trackwme!

It is basically starva but for habits, where you see people’s progress and compete with your friends!

I’ve been working hard to make this app, and I hope you guys like it!

Would love your thoughts, feedback, or ideas!

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/trackwme-social-habit-tracker/id6740893646
